basic_info.description: Unlock the potential of coastal living with this incredible 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo fixer-upper just steps from Ocean Beach.  This diamond-in-the-rough is brimming with potential. Whether you're an investor looking for your next flip or a family eager to create your dream home by the sea, this condo is the perfect canvas. With a bit of renovation and creativity, you can turn this space into a coastal haven.  The expansive floor plan features a bright and airy living & dining great room flooded with natural light from large windows. The functional kitchen and bathrooms are ready for your personal touch. Three generously sized bedrooms offer ample potential to become cozy, personalized sanctuaries. Enjoy the added convenience of a shared garage with interior access and a shared washer & dryer. Situated in the desirable Outer Richmond district, you'll enjoy beachside living with nearby parks, trails, dining, and recreation. Don't miss this chance to create your dream home by the sea!
